bureau: EveryData ECCU Ltd (regulated by the Eastern Caribbean Central Bank)
note: Credit reporting legislation has passed in every member of the Eastern Caribbean Central Bank, Saint Lucia among them, with EveryData ECCU Ltd the bureau the ECCB regulates (SKNIS, June 2024); the ECCB's harmonised bill, on which each member's act is modelled, keeps information out of credit reports seven years past the credit's settlement or termination, as Saint Lucia's enacted Credit Reporting Act, section 25, says. No source read states how many days after its due date a missed payment is reported, so the days are the game's reading: the bureau's next monthly update.

sources.title: SKNIS, Credit Reporting Legislation Passed in all ECCB Member Countries (21 June 2024)
sources.said: legislation has been passed in all member countries of the Eastern Caribbean Central Bank (ECCB). ... the ECCB is responsible for regulating any credit bureau service provider in the ECCU, which in this case is EveryData ECCU Ltd.

sources.title: Eastern Caribbean Central Bank, Summary Provisions of the Draft Harmonised Credit Reporting Bill and Regulations (Anguilla Financial Services Commission)
sources.said: Information retained seven years past settlement or termination of credit.

sources.title: Revised Laws of Saint Lucia, Credit Reporting Act, section 25 (Attorney General’s Chambers)
sources.said: the credit bureau shall not disclose such information for a period longer than 7 years after the date of termination or settlement of such credit.
